title: Paladin audit
about: Every Stage 0 Paladin card against the PC budget (book/cards/README.md, "The PC budget"), ranked from the most broken or weakest to the most balanced. Measured before any edit: the live budget under these notes is the builder's own. The research: book/research/tactical-combat.md.
classes: Lay On Hands with Shield of Faith at 15 (est.)

entries.name: Shield of Faith
entries.today: 66 a turn (fires in 82% of rounds; blocks 2d6 + [Mod], about 9)
entries.lame: No: a good moment, but its value is a number subtracted, and it alone decides the Lay On Hands build (a Smite Paladin with it would be about 167).
entries.underused: The opposite: everyone would take it.
research: Let the enemy choose its punishment (Pathfinder 2e's Glimpse of Redemption): the attacker picks between two bad outcomes, so the Reaction is good whatever it picks, and the choice is a moment at the table.
A defender's Reaction protects by drawing the blow to itself (4e's Paladin and Fighter, the MMO tanks), not by shrinking a number.
claude: Bodyguard: Interrupt, a Strike would damage an ally adjacent to you (or within 2). You swap places (Reposition) and take the hit, reduced by [Mod]. Damage moves from a fragile ally to the tank, and it fires less often (needs a SIM run).
The attacker chooses: the ally takes half the damage, or the attacker is Taunted by you for 1 round.
The cheapest fix, same shape: reduced by 1d4 + [Mod], within 2 squares (est. 15–20).

entries.name: Lay On Hands
entries.lame: Yes, the 1 AP Version: you spend your AP so the ally spends their own resource. In a fight that is worse than doing nothing.
entries.underused: The 3 AP Version: the second Rally Point adds little in a fight. It also lost its damage rider in pack R, which the class charter wanted (each Hallmark carries a little of the other side).
research: When the plain option wins, the others go unused: a help has to change the board (where the ally stands, what threatens them), not only move Health around.
claude: 1 AP: "...and they can Evade 1" (pull them out of trouble) or Guard [Mod] (about 12).
Bring back a damage rider: "your next [Strike] this turn deals an extra [R] 1d6 Ho".
3 AP: replace the second Rally Point with "and end one EoT effect on them" or "you heal the same".

entries.name: Reckoning
entries.text: While your Escalation is 3 or more (6 in Stage 0), the first [Strike] Action you make each round that deals damage to a Strained creature deals an extra [R] 1d10 Ho.
entries.lame: Yes: Escalation 6 is seldom reached and it needs a Strained target. A +1d10 nobody sees.
entries.underused: Picked only because it is the only choice.
research: Always-on bonuses are invisible; a Passive that fires at a dramatic moment reads as cinematic.
One orchestrated moment beats a small ongoing bonus.
claude: A one-off moment: "When your Escalation becomes 6, you blaze: enemies within 2 are Pushed 1 and Frightened of you (1 round), allies in your light heal [Mod]." Worth something even late.
Or a half-strength effect from Escalation 4, the full one at 6.

entries.name: Hallowed Stance
entries.text: While your Escalation is 3 or more (6 in Stage 0), you and your adjacent allies take less damage from each instance, reduced by twice your Power Modifier.
entries.lame: Yes: static, needs the party to bunch around you, and the reduction is invisible.
research: A defender draws the blow to itself (4e marks, MMO tanks) rather than shaving damage everywhere.
Always-on reductions are invisible at the table.
claude: The protective blaze: "When your Escalation becomes 6, you and allies within 2 gain Guard twice your Power Modifier."
Or the bodyguard as a Passive: "once a round, when an adjacent ally is hit, you can take the damage instead (0R)".

entries.name: Font of Mercy
entries.text: While your Escalation is 1 or more (2 in Stage 0), when you or an ally within 5 squares of you uses a Rally Point, they heal your Power Modifier + 2 more.
entries.today: 0 alone · about +4 new Health a Lay On Hands (≈48 a use, est.)
entries.lame: Yes: an invisible number on an Action only one build uses.
entries.underused: Never right for a Smite Paladin, always right for Lay On Hands: not a real choice.
research: A choice with one obvious answer is not a choice: meaningful choice needs real alternatives.
claude: Make it everyone's: "when an ally within 5 uses a Rally Point, they also gain Guard [Mod] + 2" or "you can Advance 2 toward them".
Or fold it into Lay On Hands itself and free the slot for a new Passive.

entries.name: Divine Power
entries.text: When you deal Holy damage to a creature with the Profane Tag, that creature takes 1 Bane on its [Strike] Actions (EoT).
entries.budget: The Archer's level 1 Feature, Marked Quarry: 26–39
entries.lame: Yes: it does nothing in most fights, and the Lay On Hands build seldom deals Holy damage.
entries.underused: The slot with the most room: most of the missing +35 fits here.
research: A defender punishes being ignored: 4e's Divine Challenge, homebrew Paladin marks (they need a Reaction or a limit, or they protect too well), MMO marks that weaken the target and force its attention.
claude: Judgment, the Paladin's mark: at the start of an encounter (re-mark 1 AP) one enemy is Judged. It takes 1 Bane on Strikes against anyone but you, and when it Strikes an ally anyway you can Evade 1 toward it (0R). Profane: it also takes [R] [Mod] Ho the first time each round you hit it. Target +15 to +25.

entries.name: Holy Wrath
entries.lame: Somewhat: a bigger Smite with no moment of its own.
entries.underused: Bulwark of Faith is worth more today, so it loses the pick.
research: Riders that change the board beat a bigger number.
Forced movement pays off when it hits something: Draw Steel's collisions hurt both creatures.
claude: Bring it to about 90 / 130 with a rider: Tier 3 Dazed 1 (a Severe rider, 12).
Or the cinematic one: "Pushed 2; a creature it collides with takes the same Holy dice."

entries.name: Word of Radiance
entries.lame: Partly: its Pushes from the Burst's center scatter the enemies and are worth about 0.
entries.underused: It deals half to each target (the price of a Round area) on an Encounter.
research: Forced movement needs a payoff: pushing enemies apart helps nobody; pulling them together sets up the party.
claude: Full price to each target: about 2d8 + [Mod] / 3d8 + [Mod].
Pushes become "Pulled 1 toward the center": the enemies are heaped for your allies.
Or allies in the Burst heal [Mod].

entries.name: Searing Blows
entries.text: While your Escalation is 2 or more (4 in Stage 0), your [Strike] Actions that deal damage deal an extra [R] 2 Ho.
entries.underused: One of three damage Passives that do the same thing.
research: Always-on bonuses are invisible; a Passive should change what you do.
claude: Merge Radiant Zeal, Searing Blows and Reckoning into one damage Passive.
Use this rung for: "your Smite's light grows by 1, and allies who start their turn in it gain Guard 2".

entries.name: Radiant Zeal
entries.text: While your Escalation is 1 or more (2 in Stage 0), the first [Strike] Action you make each round that deals damage deals an extra [R] 1d6 Ho.
entries.budget: The Archer's Killer's Focus, the same shape: 9 · 34
entries.lame: Yes: +1d6 once a round. The melee seat's yardstick is bigger, so the same die is worth fewer points on a Greatsword.
research: Always-on bonuses are invisible; tie a bonus to something the player does on the map.
claude: Tie it to Smite: "+1d6 on every Strike against a creature in your light".
Or simply a bigger die (1d10).

entries.name: Divine Surge
entries.text: While your Escalation is 1 or more (2 in Stage 0), at the start of each of your turns you can name one enemy within 5 squares of you. For 1 round, the first time an ally deals damage to them, they deal an extra [R] 1d8 Ho.
entries.lame: No: support damage given to an ally is a good shape.
entries.underused: The SIM's builds never pick it.
research: A defender calls a target and makes it pay for ignoring the call.
claude: 1d8 to 1d10, and the named enemy is also Taunted by you for 1 round: a defender's call.

entries.name: Bulwark of Faith
entries.today: about 50 (Guard = one Rally Point, 9, before the hit)
entries.lame: No: you step into the blow, then slide them. Good.
entries.underused: No: today it is the best Encounter Pick by far.
claude: Keep it, and raise the other Encounter Picks to its level.
Or trim the Guard to one Rally Point − 2.

entries.name: Beacon
entries.lame: No: Beacon's Step is one of the best moments in the class.
claude: 2 rounds instead of 3.
Or 2 AP and keep the 3 rounds.

entries.name: Mending Light
entries.text: While your Escalation is 2 or more (4 in Stage 0), at the start of each of your turns, you or one ally within 5 squares of you heals twice your Power Modifier + your Stage.
entries.lame: A little: a quiet heal each turn. But it is the Paladin's strongest piece.
claude: Keep it; at most heal [Mod] + Stage instead of twice [Mod].

entries.name: Smite
entries.lame: The light rider is flavor only (Bright light, a Bane on Hide). Smite 3's Push of the others in the light is worth about 0.
entries.underused: No. Its Versions scale backwards: 1 AP is the best per AP.
research: Forced movement needs a payoff: a Push away scatters, a Pull toward the target heaps enemies for the party.
A rider should change the board, not add flavor.
claude: Make the light matter: "allies' Strikes against creatures in your light gain 1 Boon" (a Mild rider, 3).
Smite 3: "Pulled 1 toward the target" instead of "Pushed 1 away": the explosion becomes a vortex.
Rebalance the Versions: the 1 AP Tier 3 die down to 1d6, the 2 AP Version up about 5.

entries.name: Rebuke
entries.lame: Slightly: pushing the attacker away after its hit leads nowhere.
research: A defender punishes being ignored by pulling the attacker into its own reach.
claude: "Pulled 2 toward you" instead of "Pushed": the attacker is dragged into your reach (a defender), likely the same price.

entries.name: Kindled Wrath
entries.text: Once an encounter, when an ally within 5 squares of you becomes Bloodied or goes Down, your Escalation increases by 1.
entries.budget: the Archer's Thrill of the Kill
entries.lame: Somewhat: +1 Escalation happens without anyone noticing.
research: A dramatic trigger deserves a visible response.
claude: Add an avenger moment: when it fires, Advance your Speed toward the creature that dropped the ally (0R).
